name: How do I make my kitchen brighter without creating harsh glare on the counters?

mainEntity.name: How do I make my kitchen brighter without creating harsh glare on the counters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Glare usually comes from exposed bright sources, reflective surfaces, narrow beams, excessive brightness, or fixtures placed directly in a sightline. It can be reduced with diffusers, recessed placement, wider or better-controlled beams, appropriate fixture height, dimming, and consistent light levels. Elite Remodeling & Design can review glare alongside countertop, backsplash, cabinet, and floor finishes. Test lighting while seated and standing because the viewing angle changes. Avoid choosing high-output fixtures solely to compensate for poorly placed task lighting. Ask for a plan that distinguishes useful illumination from visible brightness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Control glare with diffusers, thoughtful placement, wider beams, dimming, and fixtures that do not shine directly into eyes or glossy surfaces. Review the lighting while standing and seated, and compare it with the actual countertop and backsplash samples before final installation.
